verdict.rationale: RudderStack says data is stored on the customer's own infrastructure and that multi-region businesses can process data in the US, the EU, or both. The self-hostable open-source version gives further control over where data lives. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how region selection is configured, regions beyond US/EU, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Store data on your own infrastructure, not ours. Multi-region businesses can process data in the US, EU, or both individually.
The open source version of RudderStack is a standalone system dependent only on a database (PostgreSQL). It consists of 2 major components: data plane and control plane
